thread:
Samir Patel: Quick heads-up 1: trivy flagged a medium glibc issue in slimroot (ubuntu:20.04 lineage). Not an emergency but it's in images we sign and push. Proposing a targeted rebuild this week + tighten signer RBAC and add a fast revoke path. Thoughts? @security-oncall

Nina Gomez: +1. Minimal image-signer SA with only kms.cryptoSign on the signing key and storage.objects.create for attestation export. Enforce IAM Conditions (repo==infra/release && job==release) and 1h token TTL.

Jordan Lee: For KMS: per-run key versions are possible but watch quotas. Fallback is single asymmetric key + strict IAM conditions and short-lived SA. Also add a run to export cosign attestations to secure-bucket before rotation.

security-oncall: Oncall ok. Runbook must include: preflight vuln list, RBAC change, attestation export, canary rollout (2%->25->100), alerts for AsymmetricSign anomalies, and immediate actions: revoke SA binding, disable key version, add digest to OPA blocklist, rollback.

Samir Patel: ops-bot please open a maintenance ticket and schedule a Wed night window. I'll draft the runbook and include the Stackdriver filter for AsymmetricSign events.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-2026-889: "slimroot targeted rebuild + signing posture" scheduled Wed 22:00 PT. Reminder will post to status.redwood.ai.

Samir Patel: Thanks all. I'll post the runbook PR and attestation bucket path shortly.
